children: The strength seen in the trading following the last Cattle on Feed report faded out, with live cattle closing down 1.2% to $2.1935 a pound. Analysts this morning had anticipated cattle futures to continue climbing, making the move lower somewhat of a surprise for traders. But the USDA and Texas' Department of Agriculture says that a port between the U.S. and Mexico in Del Rio, Texas is being reopened to livestock exports - another step in reopening the border after cases of New World Screwworm hit the U.S. side of the border in June. Lean hogs closed up 1.6% to 70.925 cents a pound. (kirk.maltais@wsj.com)
